Numeric Technologies Inc has openings for the position SAP Analyst with bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering any, Technology, Management or related and 2 yrs of exp to analyze and apply SAP OSS Notes to resolve system issues. Participate in the migration of SAP systems from ECC to S/4HANA, including performing simplification checks, error resolution, and conducting financial data quality analysis. Create functional specifications and coordinate with developers on the development of RICEF objects. Perform Fit-Gap analysis to define optimized To-Be processes for the SAP SD implementation.
Work location is Warrenville,IL with required to travel and work from various unanticipated client worksites throughout the USA. Please mail resumes to 4200 Cantera Drive, Suite 100, Warrenville, IL- 60555. (OR) e-mail: jobs@numerictech.com

Numeric Technologies & Systems Integrator Inc is looking for a Senior SAP S/4 HANA Consultant to provide services for our client.

Job Responsibilities

As a Senior SAP S/4 HANA Consultant, you will be responsible for the following duties:

  • Leading the team in ECC to S4 HANA conversion projects by evaluating business process to conduct fit-gap analysis.
  • Address mandatory changes required by S/4HANA, such as the transition to the business partner (BP) data model.
  • Analyze all custom ABAP code (WRICEF objects) related to supply chain/logistics execution, inventory and accounting data model changes.

The performance of the above duties requires a minimum of a Bachelor's degree in Computer science, Computer information systems, information technology or in a related field.
